source: 791 Capture
target: 791 Captūra

source: After dinner, Franca and Jenna returned to 9 Rue Orosai’s Apartment 702.
target: Post cenam, Franca et Jenna redierunt ad Apartamentum 702, numero IX, in via Orosai.

source: “Finally, it worked.”
target: “Denique, successit.”

source: Franca raised her hands and stretched lazily.
target: Franca manus elevavit et languide se extendit.

source: “Next, should we find Palia the Mirror Person first, report to the Demoness of Black, or tell her tomorrow morning that I’ve become a Demoness of Affliction?
target: “Deinde, an primum inveniamus Palia, Personam Speculi, aut referamus Daemonessem Atram, aut cras mane illi dicamus me factam esse Daemonessem Afflictionis?

source: She said that once I advanced to Affliction, she would share some secrets of the Demoness Sect with me.
target: Dixit, quod, simul ac ad statum Afflictionis pervenissem, illa mihi aliquot arcana Sectae Daemonesae communicaturum esset.

source: Franca was curious but also a bit fearful about knowing these secrets.
target: Franca erat curiosa sed etiam paullo timida de his arcana cognoscendis.

source: Additionally, she felt that her progress in digesting the Pleasure potion was much faster than expected, which might arouse the Demoness of Pleasure’s suspicion.
target: Praeterea, sensit progressum suum in digestione potionis Voluptatis multo celerius esse quam expectabatur, quod suspicionem Daemonessei Voluptatis excitare posset.

source: She didn’t want to report anything related to Admiral Deep Sea yet.
target: Noluit adhuc referre quidquam de Admiro Deep Sea.

source: This involved the secret of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society’s transmigration!
target: Hoc implicabat secretum transmigrationis Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crisparum!

source: So far, Franca and Lumian had only mentioned Admiral Deep Sea’s suspected connection to elves to their respective Arcana cards and had yet to receive any response.
target: Hactenus, Franca et Lumian tantum memoraverant nexus suspectum Admirol Deep Sea cum elphis ad suas tabulas Arcana, nec ullum responsum adhuc receperunt.

source: Jenna thought for a moment and then said, “Even if you don’t go to the Demoness of Black tomorrow, you should do it soon.
target: Jenna paulisper meditata, deinde dixit: "Etiamsi cras ad Daemonessem Atram non proficiscaris, cito id agendum est."

source: The sooner we understand the Demoness Sect’s secrets, the better we can plan our actions and avoid potential pitfalls.
target: Quo citius arcana Sectae Daemonesae intellexerimus, eo melius nostra consilia statuere possumus atque casus perniciosos vitare.

source: Understanding Franca’s concerns, she added with a smile, “Just tell the Demoness of Black that Lumian has become a Reaper and he helped you digest the Pleasure potion.”
target: Intellegens Francae curas, illa cum risu addidit: "Modo Daemonessei Atram dic, Lumian factus esse Messor, et eum adiuvisse tibi ad potionem Voluptatis digerendam."

source: “Uh…” Franca was taken aback.
target: “Heu…” Franca obstupuit.

source: “That's true, but the way you put it doesn’t feel right…”
target: "Vere, sed modus quo id dicis non videtur rectus…"

source: “That’s exactly the kind of misunderstanding we need,” Jenna replied with a soft smile.
target: "Id est prorsus genus erroris quo nobis opus est," Jenna leniter respondit.

source: She glanced out at the night sky and said, “Finding Palia should be enough with just you and Anthony.
target: Caelum nocturnum intuens, illa dixit: "Palia inveniendi solum tibi et Anthonym satis esse debet."

source: I want to visit Julien in Port LeSeur in the next few days.
target: Volo Julien in Port LeSeur proximis diebus visitare.

source: We haven’t seen each other for almost two months, and I want to gauge his intentions, see if he really plans to return to Trier.
target: Iam fere per duas menses invicem non convenerimus, atque volo consilia eius perscrutari, videre an vere ad Trier redire cogitet.

source: “Sure.” Franca understood Jenna’s concerns.
target: “Certe.” Franca curas Jennae intellexit.

source: Jenna nodded.
target: Jenna annuit.

source: “I’ll go home tonight, pack some things for him, and try to leave tomorrow morning.
target: "Hac nocte domum ibo, ei aliqua condenam, et cras mane proficisci conabor.

source: The sooner I go, the sooner I can come back.”
target: Quo citius exeo, eo citius redeo possum.

source: There were plenty of steam locomotives and riverboats heading to Port LeSeur, so she didn’t worry about not getting a ticket on the spot.
target: Multa erant tramina vaporalia et navigia fluviales ad Port LeSeur profectantia, qua de causa non sollicita erat ne tessera in loco careret.

source: After a brief conversation, Jenna packed her luggage, took her suitcase, and left the apartment.
target: Post brevem conversationem, Jenna sarcinas suas conplevit, dolium tulit, et apartamentum reliquit.

source: She hadn’t followed Julien’s instructions to cancel the lease on the Rue Pasteur apartment while he was away for his exchange program in Port LeSeur, saving money.
target: Illa non secuta est iussa Julieni de locatione apartamenti in via Pasteur revocanda, dum ille, pro programmate commutationis in Port LeSeur, discessisset, pecuniam servabat.

source: She still occasionally stayed there, as if she had never left.
target: Adhuc interdum ibi remaneat, quasi numquam abierat.

source: Watching Jenna leave, Franca felt a pang of disappointment and muttered, “I was hoping we could celebrate tonight…”
target: Jenna discedentem spectans, Franca dolorem deceptionis sensit et submurmuravit: "Sperabam ut hac nocte celebraremus..."

source: She walked slowly back to her bedroom and saw that some of Jenna’s clothes and belongings had been taken away.
target: Lente rediit ad cubiculum suum et vidit aliquas vestes atque res Jennae ablatas esse.

source: As she looked at the now tidier and cleaner bedroom, Franca seemed to understand something.
target: Dum cubiculum iam melius dispositum ac purificatum aspiceret, Franca quidam sensum comprehendere videbatur.

source: She fell silent.
target: Tacuit.

source: She felt that the Affliction potion had been somewhat digested.
target: Sentiebat potionem Afflictionis aliquantum digesta esse.

source: Chug, chug, chug.
target: Tum, tum, tum.

source: A cream-colored steam train with brass patterns sped along the tracks, heading towards the capital of Lenburg, Azshara, nestled among the mountains.
target: Tramen vaporale coloris cremæ cum ornamentis aereis per semitas festinanter currebat, versus caput Lenburg, Azshara, in montibus collocatum.

source: Lumian sat in a second-class carriage, looking around leisurely.
target: Lumian in plaustro secundae classis sedebat, lente circumspiciens.

source: Without coordinates for Azshara and unwilling to go through the messenger hassle again, he chose to teleport back to the Riston Province, take a steam train to the border, and then smuggle himself across the mountains.
target: Sine coordinatis pro Azshara et nolens iterum incommoda nuntiorum pati, elegit se in Provinciam Riston dislocare, tramen vaporale sumere ad finem, atque postea per montes se clandestine transire.

source: With pre-exchanged Lenburg currency, knowledge of black market traders, and intermediaries, Lumian easily obtained new identification and bought a ticket to Azshara.
target: Cum moneta Lenburgensi prae-mutata, scientia mercatorum clandestinorum et intercessorum, Lumian facile novam identificationem adeptus est atque tessera ad Azshara emi.

source: Lenburg was a small country, so he would reach his destination by the evening.
target: Lenburg parva patria erat, itaque ad metam suam intra vesperam perveniet.

source: As Lumian observed, he noticed that Lenburg residents favored light-colored clothes and brass accessories, each carrying a book to read quietly during the journey.
target: Dum Lumian observabat, animadvertit cives Lenburgenses vestimenta levium colorum et ornamenta aenea praeferre, singuli librum quiete in itinere legere.

source: Even those who conversed did so in hushed tones.
target: Etiam qui colloquebantur, hoc submurmurantes faciebant.

source: At stops, passengers were eager to help elderly people or those dressed as scholars, showing heartfelt respect.
target: Ad stationes, viatores sperabant senes aut doctos, auxilio praestare, reverentiam sincere exhibentes.

source: No wonder this is the land of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Lumian silently mused.
target: Non mirum est hanc terram esse deum Cognitionis et Sapientiae, sed tacite meditatus Lumian.

source: Lenburg was a nation of single faith without a royal family, where the Church of Knowledge exerted strong control and influence over the country.
target: Lenburg erat natio unius fidei sine familia regia, ubi Ecclesia Cognitionis potestatem firmam et auctoritatem super patriam exercebat.

source: Perhaps sensing his gaze, the young man next to him, holding a book, glanced at Lumian’s “Lenburg Travel Guide” and asked with a low laugh, “Are you a foreigner?”
target: Forsitan sensum eius aspectus, iuvenis iuxta eum, librum tenens, in "Lenburg Iter Dux" Lumiani oculos intenxit, et risu levi rogavit: "Esne peregrinus?"

source: He spoke in Lenburg, then switched to Highlander, Loenese, Intisian, and Feysac.
target: Linguam Lenburgensem locutus est, deinde ad Highlander, Loenensem, Intisian, atque Feysac versus se vertit.

source: Lumian was a bit surprised.
target: Lumian paulum obstupefactus est.

source: A typical Lenburg second-class passenger knew so many languages?
target: An typicus viator Lenburgensis classe secunda tot linguas scivisset?

source: Moreover, it felt like the man was showing off.
target: Praeterea, videbatur vir se ostendere.

source: “Yes, I’m from Intis, and I speak Lenburg,” Lumian replied cooperatively.
target: "Etiam, ex Intis sum, et linguam Lenburgensem loquor," respondit Lumian cooperanter.

source: “What’s your name? It’s impressive you know all the North Continent languages.”
target: "Quod est tibi nomen? Mirum est, quod omnes linguas Continenti Septentrionalis nosti."

source: The young man adjusted his light-framed glasses and smiled.
target: Iuvenis oculos cum limine levi correxit et subrisit.

source: “My name is Sallent, and I’m just a small company employee.
target: "Nomen meum est Sallent, et solum parvus operarius societatis sum.

source: “Actually, once you learn one language from the North Continent, the others are easy.
target: "Revera, quoniam semel unam linguam ex Continenti Septentrionali didiceris, cetera facile sunt.

source: If you start with ancient Feysac, it’s even simpler.
target: Si incipias a antiqua Feysac, ea etiam simpliciora fiunt.

source: We Lenburgers begin learning ancient Feysac in our compulsory education.”
target: Nos Lenburgenses antiquam Feysac in nostra educatione obligatoria discere incipimus.

source: Sallent’s tone carried a hint of pride, almost looking down on other countries still plagued by illiteracy and people who didn’t know foreign languages.
target: Tonus Sallent insinuabat superbiam, paene despicens alias terras adhuc a litterarum ignorantia oppressas et homines linguas alienas nescentes.

source: In theory, yes, otherwise, I wouldn’t have mastered Highlander so quickly.
target: In ratione, ita; alioquin linguam Highlander non tam celeriter pervenerim.

source: My Dutanese is just barely passable…
target: Lingua Dutana mea vix tolerabilis est…

source: Lumian didn’t mind Sallent’s slight arrogance.
target: Lumian parvam Sallent arrogantiam non curabat.

source: The Lenburgers he met this morning all had a similar attitude.
target: Lenburgenses quos hoc mane convenit omnes talem rationem habebant.

source: Keeping his voice low, Lumian said with a smile, “You’re quite civilized, showing great respect for the elderly and scholars, and reading on the train instead of chatting or playing.”
target: Voce humili servata, Lumian cum risu dixit: "Es valde urbanus, senibus atque eruditis magna reverentia tribuens, et in tramine legens potius quam loquens aut ludens."

source: Sallent replied with restrained pride, “In Lenburg, knowledge is the most precious, and scholars have more knowledge.
target: Sallent cum temperata superbia respondit: "In Lenburg, scientia pretiosissima est, et eruditi plurimam scientiam habent.

source: Elders, throughout their lives, accumulate a lot of experiential knowledge.”
target: Senes per totam vitam suam abundantem scientiam ex experientia colligunt.

source: Sallent let out a self-deprecating laugh.
target: Sallent risum auto-deprecativum edidit.

source: “Reading is a habit from childhood and a necessity.
target: "Lectio est consuetudo ex pueritia et necessitas.

source: You wouldn’t know that our lives are filled with exams and evaluations—in school, in companies, and even in church, where we take theological tests during grand masses to show our piety and respect for the God of Knowledge.
target: Nescies quin vita nostra plena sit examinationibus et aestimationibus—in scholis, in societatibus, atque etiam in ecclesia, ubi per magnas Missas probationes theologicas capimus ut pietatem ac reverentiam erga Deum Cognitionis ostendamus.

source: Lumian suddenly felt this wasn’t necessarily a good thing.
target: Lumian subito sensit hoc non necessario esse bonum.

source: No wonder Ludwig is reluctant to return to the Church of Knowledge…
target: Non mirum est Ludwig ad Ecclesiam Cognitionis redire nolle…

source: But Aurore would love it here.
target: Sed Aurore hic id amabit.

source: She wouldn’t want to live here herself, but she’d certainly want to send me here to study…
target: Ipsa hic vivere nollet, sed certe me ad studendum hic mittere vellet…

source: Seeing the foreigner beside him fall silent, Sallent sighed and said, “That’s why I didn’t stay in Azshara after graduating.
target: Videntes peregrinum iuxta se tacuisse, Sallent suspiravit et dixit: "Ideo post lauream in Azshara non remansi."

source: The pressure is overwhelming—qualification exams, annual competency reviews, monthly company evaluations, job training exams, and so on.
target: Pressura est opprimitrix: examina ad qualificationem, recognitiones annuas competentiae, aestimationes mensuales societatis, probationes ad disciplinae munus, et cetera.

source: Lumian couldn’t help but hiss internally.
target: Lumian intus susurrare non potuit nisi.

source: So this is the daily life of Lenburgers, especially those in Azshara?
target: Itaque haec est vita cotidiana Lenburgensium, praesertim eorum in Azshara?

source: Ludwig’s vague descriptions didn’t prepare me for this.
target: Descriptiones indubiae Ludovici me ad hoc non praeparaverunt.

source: I thought only students had it hard…
target: Putabam solum discipulos esse qui difficultatibus laborarent…

source: Thank goodness Aurore took me in and not some Lenburger…
target: Gratias sit Deo quod Aurore me accepit, non aliquem Lenburgensem…

source: Talking about this made Sallent feel melancholic, prompting him to lower his head and return to his book.
target: Hac re loquendo, Sallent se melancolicum sensit, inde caput inclinare et ad librum reverti.

source: Judging by the time, Lumian realized they were close to Azshara, so he started pondering the issue of the City of Exiles, Morora.
target: Tempore iudicato, Lumian conspexit eos prope Azshara esse, et itaque de Urbe Exilorum, Morora meditari coepisse.

source: He hesitated and then asked Sallent, “Have you heard of a city called Morora?”
target: Haesitavit, deinde Sallent interrogavit: "Audivistine urbem, quae Morora vocatur?"

source: Sallent thought carefully and then replied, “No, neither in reality nor in any legends.”
target: Sallent diligenter cogitavit, deinde respondit: "Minime, nec in realitate nec in ulla fabula."

source: Lumian gave a noncommittal grunt and turned his gaze back to the quickly receding mountain scenery outside, as if their conversation was just casual small talk.
target: Lumian gruntionem indifferens edidit et oculos ad celeriter recedentem montium scaenam extra vertit, quasi eorum colloquium esset solum leviter inter se conversatum.

source: If Madam Magician couldn’t find it, I probably can’t either, unless I kidnap a demigod of the Church of Knowledge…
target: Si Domina Magica id invenire non potuit, fortasse ne ego quidem possum, nisi demideum deum Ecclesiae Cognitionis rapere conar…

source: Since the Church of Knowledge placed parts of the Abscessed Hand in Morora, can I use the connection between the body parts to find the city?
target: Cum Ecclesia Cognitionis partes Manus Abscessae in Morora collocaverit, an nexum inter corpora ad urbem detegendam uti possim?

source: The Church of Knowledge expects and allows me to go to Morora, perhaps even hoping for it. Will they give me a hint?
target: Ecclesia Cognitionis exspectat et sinit me ad Morora ire, fortasse etiam id sperans; dabuntne mihi aliquod indicium?

source: With these thoughts, Lumian grew more determined.
target: His cogitationibus, Lumian firmior factus est.

source: As dusk fell, the steam locomotive stopped at a platform paved with gray and white stone slabs.
target: Dum crepusculum adveniebat, tramen vaporale in platforma lapidibus cinereis et albis pavimentata consedit.

source: Lumian, carrying a small suitcase, walked with Sallent through the station decorated with book sculptures and brass patterns.
target: Lumian, parvam capsam ferens, cum Sallent per stationem ambulavit, quae sculpturis librorum et ornamentalibus aereis ornata erat.

source: The wind howled through the mountains, bringing cold but refreshing air.
target: Ventus per montes ululabat, aerem frigidum sed refrigerantem afferens.

source: As they approached the entrance of Azshara Steam Train Station, Lumian saw several clergy members from the Church of Knowledge in white robes trimmed with brass blocking the way, checking the documents of passengers.
target: Accedentes ad introitum Stationis Traminis Vaporalis Azsharae, Lumian cerno plures clercos Ecclesiae Cognitionis in tunicis albis cum ornamento aeneo viam obstruentes, documenta vectorum examinantes.

source: “What’s going on?” Lumian asked.
target: "Quid agitur?" inquit Lumian.

source: Sallent glanced over and casually replied, “Routine exit checks, done alternately by the Church and the government.”
target: Sallent intuebatur et leviter respondit: "Inspectiones exitiariae, vicissim ab Ecclesia et gubernatione exsequuntur."

source: “I thought they might randomly stop people to test their knowledge,” Lumian joked.
target: "Putabam fortasse eos casu homines sistere posse ad scientiam probandam," iocatus est Lumian.

source: Sallent turned his head sharply, eyes filled with fear, as if to say: “Are you a devil? Even the Church bishops wouldn’t think of that!”
target: Sallent caput subito vertit, oculis timore repletis, quasi diceret: "Esne diabolus?" Neque episcopi Ecclesiae id in mente habebunt!

source: Lumian shrugged and stepped forward to have his documents checked by the clergy.
target: Lumian umeros levavit et procedere coepit ut documenta eius a clericis examinaretur.

source: The elder leading the group scrutinized Lumian, glanced at his documents, then signaled to the others.
target: Senior, qui coetum ducebat, Lumianum diligenter examinavit, documenta eius conspectus, deinde aliis signum dedit.

source: Lumian was quickly surrounded by the clergy, all poised for action.
target: Lumian celeriter a clericis circumdatus est, omnes ad agendum parati.

source: The elder stared at him and said sternly, “We’ve found a wanted criminal.
target: Senior eum fixo intuenti et severo tono dixit: "Criminalem quaesitum invenimus.

source: Take him away!”
target: Auferte eum!

source: Uh… Lumian raised an eyebrow.
target: “Heu… Lumian supercilium sublevavit.

source: In a split second, he decided not to resist, extending his hands to let the clergy cuff him with silver handcuffs.
target: In momento, statuit non resistendum esse, manus extendens, ut clerici eum cingulis argenteis vincirent.
